promptMarker: Use the imagegen skill to create a production game home-field bitmap.

terrain_grass_base_01.subject: seamless 2D game terrain tile of lush green grass for the Mushroom Battles home field
terrain_grass_base_01.details: default grass surface, varied blades with subtle clumping, faint moss patches, dew or spore-glint sparkles. Top-down 2.5D camera angle. Seamless edges (tile must repeat without visible seams in a 3x3 grid).
terrain_grass_base_01.constraints: no characters, no props, no text, no UI overlays. Must read as walkable ground.

terrain_grass_base_02.subject: seamless 2D game terrain tile of lush green grass — secondary variation for natural repetition
terrain_grass_base_02.details: same palette as grass_base_01 but with a different blade pattern: tighter clumps, occasional small spore-flowers, a faint mycelium thread crossing one corner. Top-down 2.5D camera angle. Seamless edges.
terrain_grass_base_02.constraints: no characters, no props, no text. Must tile seamlessly with grass_base_01.

terrain_grass_flowers_01.subject: seamless 2D game terrain tile of green grass with tiny clover and pale-amber spore flowers
terrain_grass_flowers_01.details: default grass surface with a small cluster of low-density spore flowers (amber and bone-white). Flowers fade naturally at tile edges so the tile tiles cleanly.
terrain_grass_flowers_01.constraints: no characters, no props, no text. Flowers must not extend beyond the tile boundary.

terrain_path_dirt_straight.subject: seamless 2D game terrain tile of a packed earth path segment crossing the tile horizontally
terrain_path_dirt_straight.details: warm umber dirt path with small embedded pebbles and faint mushroom-root traces along the edges. The path crosses the tile horizontally and meets edges at the same Y position so it joins cleanly with adjacent path tiles.
terrain_path_dirt_straight.constraints: no characters, no text. Path must align horizontally for tiling.

terrain_path_spore_glow.subject: seamless 2D game terrain tile of a packed earth path with a soft amber spore glow running along its center
terrain_path_spore_glow.details: same dirt path as path_dirt_straight but with a faint amber bioluminescent strip running down the center line, suggesting the path leads to the Arena.
terrain_path_spore_glow.constraints: Path edges must align with path_dirt_straight for tiling.

terrain_path_destination_row.subject: seamless 2D game terrain tile of a mycelium-veined path running along the top destination row of the field
terrain_path_destination_row.details: Wider, more decorative path with subtle violet and amber mycelium veins, suggesting the path connects the Arena and Journey entrances at the top of the field. Path crosses horizontally; edges align.

terrain_edge_roots_01.subject: seamless 2D game terrain tile of dense root growth marking the edge of the walkable field
terrain_edge_roots_01.details: Thick mushroom roots and tangled mycelium creating a visual border. Reads as 'do not pass'.
terrain_edge_roots_01.constraints: Must read clearly as a blocked edge, not as a path.

terrain_edge_moss_rocks_01.subject: seamless 2D game terrain tile of mossy rocks and forest debris marking a blocked field edge
terrain_edge_moss_rocks_01.details: Cluster of moss-covered stones, fallen leaves, small mushroom growth. Reads as 'do not pass'.

prop_mushroom_cluster_small_amber.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: small cluster of amber-glowing mushrooms
prop_mushroom_cluster_small_amber.details: 3-5 mushrooms with rounded amber-glowing caps and pale stems, gathered as a foreground detail. Lighting matches style anchor. Subtle elliptical shadow under the cluster (semi-transparent warm umber).
prop_mushroom_cluster_small_amber.constraints: Centered cluster; anchor point at bottom-center (visual base). No characters, no text.

prop_mushroom_cluster_small_violet.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: small cluster of violet bioluminescent mushrooms
prop_mushroom_cluster_small_violet.details: Similar composition to amber cluster but with cool violet glow. Provides color contrast across the field. Subtle elliptical shadow under the cluster.
prop_mushroom_cluster_small_violet.constraints: Centered cluster; anchor point at bottom-center. No characters, no text.

prop_mushroom_cluster_tall_green.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: tall cluster of green-capped mushrooms with thick stems
prop_mushroom_cluster_tall_green.details: 3-4 mushrooms standing 2x taller than they are wide. Top half is mushroom caps; bottom half is stems and moss. Provides forest depth at field edges.
prop_mushroom_cluster_tall_green.constraints: Anchor point at bottom-center. Caps must read as taller than a chibi (mushrooms feel imposing).

prop_mushroom_cap_red_spotted.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: a single red mushroom with white-spotted cap, the classic fairytale silhouette
prop_mushroom_cap_red_spotted.details: Iconic red-and-white toadstool with a stylized Mycelium twist (organic, slightly bioluminescent rim). Familiar enough to be a landmark.
prop_mushroom_cap_red_spotted.constraints: Centered, bottom-anchored. No characters, no text.

prop_mycelium_lantern_amber.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: an amber spore lantern shaped like a tall mushroom with a glowing cap
prop_mycelium_lantern_amber.details: A mushroom-shaped lantern with a warm amber glow inside the cap, casting a soft halo. Used near the Arena entrance for lighting. Stem and base look hand-carved or organic.
prop_mycelium_lantern_amber.constraints: Anchor at bottom-center. Glow must read clearly.

prop_fallen_branch_mycelium.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: a fallen branch wrapped in mycelium and small mushroom growth
prop_fallen_branch_mycelium.details: Horizontal organic obstacle. Branch is half-claimed by fungus. Reads as 'walkable around, not through'.
prop_fallen_branch_mycelium.constraints: Anchor at bottom-center of the branch.

prop_signpost_blank.subject: transparent-background 2D game prop: an art-only wooden signpost made from organic carved mushroom wood
prop_signpost_blank.details: Tall signpost with a flat sign-board on top. The board surface is intentionally BLANK (no text, no symbols) because runtime will render localized text overlay on top. Sign material is carved mushroom wood with mycelium veins.
prop_signpost_blank.constraints: Anchor at bottom-center. CRITICAL: the sign-board MUST be blank — no readable text, no icons, no characters. Just the carved wood/mycelium surface.

exit_arena_mushroom_arch.subject: transparent-background 2D game entrance prop: an Arena entrance formed by two giant living mushrooms forming an arch
exit_arena_mushroom_arch.details: Two large mushroom trunks lean toward each other forming a doorway arch. Warm amber spore lanterns hang from the underside of the arch. Small battle banners (no text, just abstract heraldic shapes — fungal motifs) drape from the arch. Inside the arch a soft amber glow suggests a portal beyond. Roots and mycelium spread from the base.
exit_arena_mushroom_arch.constraints: Anchor at bottom-center (base of the arch). No characters inside the arch. No readable text on the banners. Reads as combat-ready and inviting.

exit_journey_gate_under_construction.subject: transparent-background 2D game entrance prop: a mossy path into a deeper mushroom forest, blocked by organic vine rope and small construction signs
exit_journey_gate_under_construction.details: Stone-and-mushroom gate posts on either side. Organic vine rope strung between them, blocking entry. Small wooden warning signs hang from the rope (signs are art-only, no readable text). Behind the gate, the path continues into a darker, foggier forest. A dim violet lantern hangs at the side. Mood: whimsical, not modern; clearly reads as 'not available yet'.
exit_journey_gate_under_construction.constraints: Anchor at bottom-center. No characters. Sign-boards must be art-only blank surfaces (no text).

effect_spore_motes_loop.subject: transparent-background 2D game effect spritesheet: 8 frames of drifting amber spore motes for an ambient field overlay
effect_spore_motes_loop.details: Each frame shows 4-6 small soft amber motes drifting slowly upward against transparent background. Across the 8 frames the motes move incrementally upward, fade in/out, and re-spawn at the bottom — a looping cycle. Each frame is 256x256, all 8 frames laid out in a single 2048x256 horizontal strip.
effect_spore_motes_loop.transparency: transparent background required (alpha channel must be honored)
effect_spore_motes_loop.constraints: No solid background. Motes are diffuse, soft-edged, not hard sprites. Animation loops cleanly from frame 8 back to frame 1.

effect_arena_portal_shimmer.subject: transparent-background 2D game effect spritesheet: 8 frames of a warm amber portal shimmer for the Arena arch interior
effect_arena_portal_shimmer.details: Sized to overlay the inside of the Arena arch. Each frame shows a slightly different distortion / wave pattern of amber light, suggesting a magical portal. 512x512 per frame, 8 frames in a 4096x512 horizontal strip.
effect_arena_portal_shimmer.constraints: Animation loops cleanly. No solid background. No hard edges.

effect_mycelium_path_pulse.subject: transparent-background 2D game effect spritesheet: 8 frames of a bioluminescent pulse running along the path tile toward the Arena
effect_mycelium_path_pulse.details: Each frame shows a soft pulse of amber-violet light traveling horizontally across a 256x256 area. Frame 1 shows the pulse on the left edge; frame 8 shows it on the right edge. Loop cleanly. Designed to overlay path_spore_glow tiles.
effect_mycelium_path_pulse.constraints: Pulse is soft, not a hard line. Loops cleanly.

effect_journey_blocked_rustle.subject: transparent-background 2D game effect spritesheet: 8 frames of vine/rope rustle around the Journey gate's blocking ropes
effect_journey_blocked_rustle.details: Subtle motion of vines and ropes shifting in a gentle breeze. 256x256 per frame, 8 frames in a 2048x256 horizontal strip. Designed to overlay the Journey gate.
effect_journey_blocked_rustle.constraints: Loops cleanly. Motion is small and ambient.

effect_tap_ripple.subject: transparent-background 2D game effect spritesheet: 4 frames of a tap-to-move ripple at the player's tap point
effect_tap_ripple.details: Frame 1: small bright amber dot. Frame 2: expanding bright ring with the dot fading. Frame 3: larger softer ring. Frame 4: barely visible faded ring. 128x128 per frame, 4 frames in a 512x128 horizontal strip. Used as one-shot animation (no loop) at the tap position.

character_placeholder_silhouette.subject: transparent-background chibi placeholder spritesheet for a mushroom heroine — 8 columns x 4 rows of 64x64 frames
character_placeholder_silhouette.details: Generic mushroom-elf chibi silhouette to serve as a fallback when a specific character's chibi hasn't been generated yet. Visible elf ears. Mushroom cap hat (neutral colors, not character-specific). Row order top to bottom: facing down, facing up, facing left, facing right. Each row: 2 idle frames + 6 walk frames = 8 frames. Walk frames show a clear stride cycle. Idle frames show a subtle breathing motion.
character_placeholder_silhouette.size: 512x256 spritesheet, 8 cols x 4 rows of 64x64 frames
character_placeholder_silhouette.constraints: Each 64x64 frame is centered; chibi feet near bottom of frame. Walk cycle reads cleanly across the 6 walk frames per direction. Elf ears visible in all 4 directions. Cute chibi proportions: large head, small body, ~3 heads tall.
